cases.purpose: --since/--until on the live /dev/kmsg ring select records at/after and at/before microsecond-exact timestamps read independently from the raw device; a ~900-byte record is returned intact
cases.oracle: Independent raw /dev/kmsg timestamps (python os.read, one record per read) of three seeded user-facility records, and util-linux dmesg for the long record
cases.comparison: Exact inclusive since/until boundaries (equal bounds select one record, one microsecond outside selects none) and the long record against util-linux dmesg.
cases.script:
[[ $UID == 0 && $EUID == 0 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
[[ $(type -t dmesg) == builtin ]] || exit 125
lvl=$(/usr/bin/cut -f1 /proc/sys/kernel/printk)
trap 'echo $lvl > /proc/sys/kernel/printk' EXIT
/usr/bin/mkfifo wait.fifo; exec 8<>wait.fifo
pause() { read -t "$1" -u 8; }
/usr/bin/dmesg -C || { echo SETUP-FAILED; exit 97; }
for i in 1 2 3; do printf '<14>w6-seed: record %s\n' $i >/dev/kmsg; pause 0.3; done
/usr/bin/python3 -I - >"$HOME/ts" <<'PY'
import os
fd = os.open("/dev/kmsg", os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NONBLOCK)
ts = []
while True:
    try:
        rec = os.read(fd, 8192).decode()
    except BlockingIOError:
        break
    head, _, text = rec.partition(";")
    if text.startswith("w6-seed: record"):
        us = int(head.split(",")[2])
        ts.append(us)
print(" ".join("%d.%06d" % (u // 1000000, u % 1000000) for u in ts), " ".join(str(u) for u in ts))
PY
read -r a b c u1 u2 u3 <"$HOME/ts"
fmt() { local us=$1; printf '%d.%06d' $((us / 1000000)) $((us % 1000000)); }
show() { local o; o=$("$@" 2>&1); echo "[${o//$'\n'/|}]"; }
echo "ordered=$([[ $u1 -lt $u2 && $u2 -lt $u3 ]] && echo 1 || echo 0) count=$(( $# + 3 ))"
echo "exact: $(show dmesg -f user -t --since $(fmt $u2) --until $(fmt $u2))"
echo "since-t2: $(show dmesg -f user -t --since $(fmt $u2))"
echo "until-t2: $(show dmesg -f user -t --until $(fmt $u2))"
echo "after-t3: $(show dmesg -f user -t --since $(fmt $((u3 + 1))))"
echo "before-t1: $(show dmesg -f user -t --until $(fmt $((u1 - 1))))"
echo "equals-bounds-eq-u1-u3: $(show dmesg -f user -t --since $(fmt $u1) --until $(fmt $u3))"
long=$(printf 'x%.0s' {1..900})
printf '<14>w6-long: %s\n' "$long" >/dev/kmsg
mine=$(dmesg -f user -t | /usr/bin/tail -n 1); ref=$(/usr/bin/dmesg -f user -t | /usr/bin/tail -n 1)
echo "long-record: equal-to-util-linux=$([[ $mine == "$ref" ]] && echo 1 || echo 0) length=${#mine}"
cases.stdout:
ordered=1 count=3
exact: [w6-seed: record 2]
since-t2: [w6-seed: record 2|w6-seed: record 3]
until-t2: [w6-seed: record 1|w6-seed: record 2]
after-t3: []
before-t1: []
equals-bounds-eq-u1-u3: [w6-seed: record 1|w6-seed: record 2|w6-seed: record 3]
long-record: equal-to-util-linux=1 length=909
